cues: Increase the damping to a special value, where b squared equals four m k, and the body returns to rest in the shortest possible time, without overshooting at all.
Galvanometers and car shock absorbers are designed this way.
text: Increase the damping to a special value, where b squared equals four m k, and the body returns to rest in the shortest possible time, without overshooting at all. That is critical damping. Galvanometers and car shock absorbers are designed this way.
